Manifest.Name: Precision Mixer / 精密配比机
Manifest.Author: XuFly
Manifest.Description: Mix fluids to a target percentage using source bottles. English / 中文. Buy from Dr. Jackson; 2 power per mix. Back up saves; empty and remove machines before uninstalling. 使用原料瓶调配指定百分比，支持中英文。杰克逊博士处购买，每次耗电2。请备份存档；卸载前取出瓶子与电池并处理掉机器。
